The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced a major expansion of the BEYOND program to integrate drones into the national airspace system, which will double the program's size by adding up to eight lead participants [FAA announced the expansion](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-announces-major-expansion-faa-beyond-program). This move coincides with a broader push for drone integration, as 1.8 million registered U.S. drones are strengthening the shift toward beyond visual line of sight operations [registered drones strengthen shift](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxOUlJzRk5FOXVFdWNETWRMRHVzOExJVW9LUUJxUm9HZTRPSjJqTjd3NjdzMC1ZYWlPWXZJQTdpd0M0b0hTSm1Kd1ZQMFIyOHAtMUNMM292TmZTdzQ3VzM5LVBscVlUVy11ZzFjaURqbVZWb0lOa3hkTDZEU1dkV19OQ3FjM081ZlJ4OGpkV2JHMjNQdl9zSkhWakFBTV9wQQ?oc=5).

The U.S. Department of Transportation is also prioritizing aviation infrastructure and management. The agency invested $10.9 million to equip 3,000 runway vehicles with transmitters at 61 airports [USDOT invested in transmitters](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-delivers-11-billion-upgrade-airports) and delivered 191 grants to improve airport infrastructure across 36 states and two territories [FAA delivering 191 grants](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-invests-481-million-ahead-labor-day-weekend). Additionally, the FAA delivered a new air traffic control management tool called SMART that centralizes 200 data streams to improve airspace management and flight scheduling [FAA delivered SMART](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-delivers-state-art-air-traffic-control).

In advanced aviation and autonomy, the FAA launched a federal eVTOL pilot program in North Carolina [FAA launched pilot program](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-celebrates-launch-federal-evtol-pilot-0). Meanwhile, Tesla launched the Cybercab in Austin [Tesla launched Cybercab](https://www.google.'). These developments reflect a trend toward the commercialization of autonomous transport systems.
